<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation
GLM-5.3-Flash already supports interleave prefill context parallelism,
but its prefill CUDA Graphs are automatically disabled. This leaves
CP prefill running eagerly and prevents it from benefiting from
breakable CUDA Graph replay.

Enable BCG for the supported GLM CP configuration while preserving
correct CP-local DSA indexing, global-sequence KDA recurrence, and
KDA state transfer in NIXL-based PD deployments.

## Modifications

- Extend CP+BCG eligibility to GLM-5.3-Flash with interleave CP and
  TileLang or `flashmla_sparse_q8` DSA prefill.
- Preserve the requested prefill graph backend for eligible configurations
  instead of unconditionally disabling it.
- Restrict support to full-width CP with DP1/PP1, no speculative decoding,
  and no DSA cache-layer splitting.
- Require exact capture-bucket matches for GLM replay; unmatched token
  counts fall back to eager execution to preserve KDA recurrence geometry.
- Use CP-local token counts for KPool indexer graph outputs, while keeping
  global token counts for KDA graph metadata.
- Restore global causal positions for KPool compression when BCG uses
  CP-local position buffers, and normalize interleave splitter lengths
  to `int32`.
- Enable NIXL PD prefill with CP/TP group sharing, route KDA state shards
  to matching decode TP ranks, and validate state-layout compatibility.
- Avoid advancing receiver-visible chunk IDs for empty, non-final KV
  transfers while preserving final state notifications.

## Accuracy Tests

Validated GLM-5.3-Flash on 4 × H200 with cp and BCG

```bash
sglang serve \
  --model-path /path/to/GLM-5.3-Flash \
  --served-model-name llm \
  --tp-size 4 \
  --ep-size 4 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.75 \
  --dsa-prefill-backend tilelang \
  --dsa-decode-backend tilelang \
  --kv-cache-dtype bfloat16 \
  --moe-runner-backend deep_gemm \
  --enable-prefill-cp \
  --cp-strategy interleave \
  --attn-cp-size 4 \
  --chunked-prefill-size 8192 \
  --cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8009 \
  --reasoning-parser auto \
  --tool-call-parser auto \
```
GSM8K: 1,314 scored questions per run, 5-shot, temperature 0


 | BCG| Run 1 (rounded) | Run 2 (rounded) | Mean | 
 | -- | -- | -- | -- | 
| off | 95.7% | 95.7% | 95.7% | 
 | on | 96.0% | 95.7% | 95.9% | 

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`

+    )
+    values.update(updates)
+    return SimpleNamespace(**values)
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def _policy(cfg, architecture=GLM, attention="dsa"):
+    model = SimpleNamespace(hf_config=SimpleNamespace(architectures=[architecture]))
+    with (
+        patch.object(bcg, "resolving_view", return_value=cfg),
+        patch.object(bcg, "resolved_view", return_value=cfg),
+        patch.object(bcg, "attention_backends_of", return_value=(attention, attention)),
+        patch.object(bcg, "model_config_of", return_value=model),
+        patch.object(sharing, "resolving_view", return_value=cfg),
+        patch.object(sharing, "resolved_view", return_value=cfg),
+        patch.object(
+            sharing,
+            "mambaish_config",
+            return_value=SimpleNamespace(
+                linear_num_key_heads=16, linear_num_value_heads=64
+            ),
+        ),
+        patch.object(
+            sharing.envs.SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER, "get", return_value=False
+        ),
+    ):
+        yield model
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("backend", ["tilelang", "flashmla_sparse_q8"])
+def test_glm_cp_bcg_accepts_qualified_backends(backend):
+    cfg = _config(dsa_prefill_backend=backend)
+    with _policy(cfg):
+        assert bcg.supports_prefill_cp_bcg(cfg)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "updates",
+    [
+        {"enable_prefill_cp": False},
+        {"attn_cp_size": 2},
+        {"attn_cp_size": 1, "tp_size": 1},
+        {"dp_size": 2},
+        {"pp_size": 2},
+        {"speculative_algorithm": "EAGLE"},
+        {"enable_dsa_cache_layer_split": True},
+        {"dsa_prefill_backend": "trtllm"},
+        {"cp_strategy": "zigzag"},
+    ],
+)
+def test_glm_cp_bcg_keeps_unqualified_configs_eager(updates):
+    cfg = _config(**updates)
+    with _policy(cfg):
+        assert not bcg.supports_prefill_cp_bcg(cfg)
+
+
+def test_other_dsa_architectures_do_not_gain_bcg():
+    cfg = _config()
+    with _policy(cfg, architecture="DeepseekV32ForCausalLM"):
+        assert not bcg.supports_prefill_cp_bcg(cfg)
+
+
+def test_dsv4_stays_excluded_as_on_main():
+    cfg = _config()
+    with _policy(cfg, architecture="DeepseekV4ForCausalLM", attention="dsv4"):
+        assert not bcg.supports_prefill_cp_bcg(cfg)
+
+
+def test_upstream_zigzag_trtllm_mha_still_supported():
+    cfg = _config(cp_strategy="zigzag")
+    with _policy(cfg, architecture=QWEN, attention="trtllm_mha"):
+        assert bcg.supports_prefill_cp_bcg(cfg)
+
+
+def test_glm_nixl_prefill_sharing_preserves_graph_config():
+    cfg = _config(disaggregation_mode="prefill")
+    with _policy(cfg) as model, patch.object(sharing, "declare_resolution") as declare:
+        sharing.resolve_cp_tp_group_sharing(cfg, model)
+    assert declare.call_args.kwargs["enable_cp_tp_group_sharing"]
+    assert declare.call_args.kwargs["cuda_graph_config"] is cfg.cuda_graph_config
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "updates",
+    [
+        {
+            "disaggregation_mode": "prefill",
+            "disaggregation_transfer_backend": "mooncake",
+        },
+        {"disaggregation_mode": "decode"},
+        {"disaggregation_mode": "prefill", "speculative_algorithm": "EAGLE"},
+        {"dp_size": 2},
+        {"pp_size": 2},
+    ],
+)
+def test_glm_sharing_rejects_unqualified_pd_topologies(updates):
+    cfg = _config(**updates)
+    with _policy(cfg) as model, pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        sharing.resolve_cp_tp_group_sharing(cfg, model)
+
+
+def test_upstream_qwen_pd_policy_is_not_restricted_by_glm_rules():
+    cfg = _config(
+        cp_strategy="zigzag",
+        ep_size=1,
+        dp_size=2,
+        disaggregation_mode="prefill",
+        disaggregation_transfer_backend="mooncake",
+    )
+    with (
+        _policy(cfg, architecture=QWEN, attention="trtllm_mha") as model,
+        patch.object(sharing, "declare_resolution") as declare,
+    ):
+        sharing.resolve_cp_tp_group_sharing(cfg, model)
+    assert declare.call_args.kwargs["enable_cp_tp_group_sharing"]
+
+
+def test_upstream_glm_native_mtp_remains_available_with_eager_prefill():
+    cfg = _config(speculative_algorithm="EAGLE")
+    with (
+        _policy(cfg) as model,
+        patch.object(sharing, "with_phase", return_value="disabled"),
+        patch.object(sharing, "declare_resolution") as declare,
+    ):
+        sharing.resolve_cp_tp_group_sharing(cfg, model)
+    assert declare.call_args.kwargs["enable_cp_tp_group_sharing"]
+    assert declare.call_args.kwargs["cuda_graph_config"] == "disabled"
+
+
+def test_glm_kda_replay_requires_exact_capture_bucket():
+    init_cp_strategy(enable_prefill_cp=True, cp_size=4, cp_strategy="interleave")
+    graph_input = bcg.PrefillCPBCGInput(
+        input_embeds=torch.empty(0),
+        positions=torch.empty(0),
+        bucket_local_tokens={1024: 256, 2048: 512},
+    )
+    model = SimpleNamespace(hf_config=SimpleNamespace(architectures=[GLM]))
+    try:
+        with (
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.runtime_context.process_model_config", return_value=model
+            ),
+            patch.object(bcg, "get_cp_padding_align_size", return_value=4),
+        ):
+            assert (
+                graph_input.select_replay_bucket_for_batch(
+                    num_tokens=1000,
+                    extend_seq_lens=[1000],
+                    capture_num_tokens=[1024, 2048],
+                    max_padding_factor=2,
+                )
+                is None
+            )
+            assert (
+                graph_input.select_replay_bucket_for_batch(
+                    num_tokens=1024,
+                    extend_seq_lens=[1024],
+                    capture_num_tokens=[1024, 2048],
+                    max_padding_factor=2,
+                )
+                == 1024
+            )
+    finally:
+        init_cp_strategy(enable_prefill_cp=False, cp_size=1, cp_strategy="zigzag")
